project.name: vvroom

tour.title: Project Overview
tour.description: Start with the README and architecture documentation to understand Vvroom's purpose: an Angular 14 web application for automobile data discovery and visualization. The architecture overview covers the frontend structure, service dependency graph, domain configuration pattern, pop-out window communication, and deployment via Docker/Kubernetes. This provides the mental map for everything that follows.

tour.title: Application Bootstrap
tour.description: The application starts at main.ts, which conditionally enables production mode and bootstraps the AppModule. AppModule is the root Angular module (fan-out: 11) that wires together feature components, framework services, PrimeNG UI imports, error handling, HTTP interception, and the automobile domain configuration provider. The environment file, imported by 13 other files (highest fan-in in the project), controls API URLs and feature flags for development vs. production.
tour.languageLesson: Angular modules use the @NgModule decorator to declare components, import dependencies, and provide services. The bootstrap array tells Angular which component to render first. Environment files are swapped at build time via angular.json's fileReplacements configuration.

tour.title: Routing and App Shell
tour.description: The root component provides the application shell: a dark-themed navigation header with Home/Discover links, a router-outlet for feature views, global toast notifications, and a footer. The routing module maps URL paths to feature components with a default redirect to home. This establishes the two main views a user will navigate between.

tour.title: Core Type System
tour.description: The DomainConfig interface (fan-in: 12, second-highest in the project) is the single most important type -- it defines the complete schema for a domain's API endpoints, table layout, filters, pickers, charts, feature flags, and adapter functions. All framework components and services program against this interface, making the entire application domain-agnostic. The resource definition, filter definition, and table config interfaces establish the vocabulary used throughout the codebase.
tour.languageLesson: TypeScript interfaces define structural contracts without runtime overhead. The DomainConfig interface uses generics and optional properties extensively, allowing domain implementations to pick which features they need while the framework provides type-safe defaults for the rest.

tour.title: URL-First State Management
tour.description: Vvroom's most distinctive architectural decision is URL-first reactive state. The UrlStateService (fan-in: 7) bidirectionally synchronizes application state with URL query parameters, making every filter combination a shareable link. The ResourceManagementService (fan-in: 9) orchestrates the full data lifecycle: it reads URL state, converts it to API parameters via adapters, fetches data, and exposes reactive observables for filters, results, loading state, and errors. The state management specification documents this architecture in depth.
tour.languageLesson: RxJS BehaviorSubjects hold and emit the latest value to new subscribers, making them ideal for representing application state. The combineLatest operator merges multiple state streams so that any URL parameter change triggers a new API request and UI update.

tour.title: API and Request Coordination
tour.description: The ApiService wraps Angular's HttpClient with typed CRUD methods and centralized error handling. The RequestCoordinatorService adds three layers of request optimization: TTL-based response caching, in-flight request deduplication via shareReplay, and automatic retry with exponential backoff. The HTTP error interceptor provides consistent error formatting with retry policies for transient 5xx and 429 errors, while the global error handler catches all unhandled exceptions and routes them to user-friendly notifications.

tour.title: Generic Adapters
tour.description: The adapter layer bridges domain-specific data and the framework's generic services. The GenericUrlMapper bidirectionally converts between filter objects and URL query parameters with type-aware serialization, validation, and sanitization. The GenericApiAdapter converts filter objects to API query params, handles sorting and highlighting, and transforms API responses using pluggable data and statistics transformers. These adapters are configured per-domain, keeping the framework completely domain-agnostic.

tour.title: Automobile Domain Configuration
tour.description: The automobile domain is the concrete implementation of the DomainConfig pattern. The factory function (fan-out: 18, tied for highest) assembles the complete automobile configuration by combining resource definitions, generic adapters, chart data sources, filter configs, and feature flags into a single DomainConfig object. The automobile resource file is the single source of truth for all field definitions -- filters, pagination, sorting, table columns, API endpoints -- that drive URL mapping, API parameters, and UI rendering.
tour.languageLesson: The factory function pattern creates and assembles complex objects in a single function call. Angular's InjectionToken and useFactory provider allow the DomainConfig to be injected anywhere in the component tree without tight coupling to the automobile implementation.

tour.title: Discovery Dashboard
tour.description: The discover component (fan-out: 16, third-highest) is the main user-facing feature -- a multi-panel dashboard orchestrating charts, pickers, results tables, statistics, and query controls. It supports drag-and-drop panel reordering via Angular CDK, collapsible sections, pop-out window management for multi-monitor workflows, and URL-driven state synchronization. User panel preferences (order, collapsed state) persist via the UserPreferencesService with backend API storage and localStorage fallback.

tour.title: Framework UI Components
tour.description: The framework provides a suite of reusable, domain-agnostic components. The base chart wraps Plotly.js with error recovery and click-to-filter events. The query control renders filter chips with multiselect and range dialogs. The base picker supports searchable, paginated selection with URL state hydration. Three results table variants (basic, dynamic, filtered) handle different data display needs with pagination, sorting, and row expansion. The statistics panel arranges charts in a drag-and-drop grid with pop-out support.
tour.languageLesson: Angular's @Input and @Output decorators define a component's public API. @Input receives configuration (like DomainConfig-driven column definitions), while @Output emits events (like filter changes) upward. This one-way data flow keeps components reusable across domains.

tour.title: Chart Data Sources
tour.description: Four chart data source classes transform VehicleStatistics into Plotly.js chart configurations: manufacturer distribution (stacked bar), top models (horizontal bar), body class (pie chart), and year distribution (bar chart). Each supports highlight-aware segmentation that visually separates filtered vs. total data, and click-to-filter interactivity that applies the clicked category as a URL filter. These data sources are plugged into the automobile DomainConfig from Step 8.

tour.title: Pop-Out Window System
tour.description: Vvroom supports popping any dashboard panel into a separate browser window for multi-monitor workflows. The PopOutContextService (fan-in: 11, third-highest) manages cross-window communication via the BroadcastChannel API, enabling state synchronization between parent and child windows. The PopOutManagerService orchestrates window lifecycle including opening, state broadcasting, polling-based health checks, and cleanup. The panel-popout component uses ngSwitch to render any panel type in the standalone window.

tour.title: AI Chat Integration
tour.description: The AI chat panel provides a conversational assistant powered by a local Ollama LLM backend. The AiService manages multi-model selection (text, vision, DeepSeek), message processing with embedded query extraction, model preloading, and automobile-specific API context generation. The component supports image paste/upload, markdown and LaTeX rendering via KaTeX, connection health checking, and expandable layout. This feature extends the discovery experience beyond traditional search and filtering.

tour.title: End-to-End Testing
tour.description: The Playwright test suites validate the application's three most critical behaviors: visual appearance (correct rendering of tables, charts, filters), URL conformity (bidirectional URL-to-UI state mapping), and URL consistency (browser back/forward navigation correctly restoring state). The shared screenshot helper provides page navigation, panel management, and screenshot stitching utilities. These tests lock in the URL-first architecture from Step 5 as a verified contract.

tour.title: Build and Configuration
tour.description: The project's build toolchain centers on Angular CLI configured via angular.json, which defines build targets, SCSS styling, production/development configs with bundle budgets, and environment file replacements. The proxy configuration forwards /api requests to a local backend during development. TypeScript strict mode with Angular template checking ensures type safety across templates and dependency injection. The package.json reveals key runtime dependencies: PrimeNG for UI components, Plotly.js for charting, RxJS for reactive state, and KaTeX for LaTeX rendering.
